description: Desktop window for the AE AI shell — cost, history and settings
_status: RUN AND VERIFIED 2026-07-20 late night (ENGINEERING_LOG §D.7), both paths: reuse (window loads the dashboard of an already-running kernel, spawns nothing, leaves it alive on quit) and spawn (no kernel -> it starts one).
